title: Restored Name King James Version (RNKJV)
description: A modern revision of the King James Version that restores *Elohim* and *Yahweh* in place of the conventional 'God' and 'the Lord' renderings. Used throughout the 2005 English-language omnibus edition of *Intelligent Design — Message From the Designers*.
